performance_history.grading_summary: Issue #7 was the most recent real send and the one graded this run (there was a five-week gap and no post on 2026-09-22). Against the issue #1 baseline it performed reasonably for a ~13-recipient list: 30.77% open rate (4 of 13) and a 25% verified click rate show engaged readers, and deliverability was perfect at 100% with zero spam complaints. The weak spot was retention, one unsubscribe (7.69% of recipients) and a net drift down to 12 active subscribers, which on a list this small is noise but still the trend to watch. The takeaway is that content engagement is healthy while list growth is the real constraint; audience acquisition matters more than any single-issue tweak right now.
